name: When should I consider fence replacement instead of restoration?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider fence replacement instead of restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider fence replacement instead of restoration when the majority of your fence is severely damaged, decaying, or compromised structurally. If the cost of repairing multiple sections approaches or exceeds the cost of a new fence, replacement is often the more economical and long-term solution. Significant widespread rot, irreparable foundational issues, or severe storm damage across large sections are common reasons to opt for replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacement if most of the fence is severely damaged, decaying, or if repair costs are comparable to a new fence.
